<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn2:definitions xmlns:bpmn2="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" xmlns:configEx="http://config-ex/schema" xmlns:elEx="http://element-ex/schema" id="cogover-diagram" targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn">
  <bpmn2:process id="PEOMNI00000001" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn2:startEvent id="NO000000000110" name="Start"><bpmn2:extensionElements><configEx:elementInfo renderKey="START_NORMAL_EVENT" /></bpmn2:extensionElements><bpmn2:outgoing>FLOMNI00000001</bpmn2:outgoing></bpmn2:startEvent>
    <bpmn2:sendTask id="NOOMNI00000001" name="Send Zalo message"><bpmn2:extensionElements><elEx:omniMessageTask /><configEx:elementInfo renderKey="OMNI_MESSAGE_TASK" /></bpmn2:extensionElements><bpmn2:incoming>FLOMNI00000001</bpmn2:incoming><bpmn2:outgoing>FLOMNI00000002</bpmn2:outgoing></bpmn2:sendTask>
    <bpmn2:endEvent id="NOOMNIEND00001" name="End Process"><bpmn2:extensionElements><configEx:elementInfo renderKey="END_EVENT" /></bpmn2:extensionElements><bpmn2:incoming>FLOMNI00000002</bpmn2:incoming></bpmn2:endEvent>
    <bpmn2:sequenceFlow id="FLOMNI00000001" sourceRef="NO000000000110" targetRef="NOOMNI00000001" /><bpmn2:sequenceFlow id="FLOMNI00000002" sourceRef="NOOMNI00000001" targetRef="NOOMNIEND00001" />
  </bpmn2:process>
  <bpmndi:BPMNDiagram id="BPMNDiagram_OMNI"><bpmndi:BPMNPlane id="BPMNPlane_OMNI" bpmnElement="PEOMNI00000001">
    <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="NO000000000110_di" bpmnElement="NO000000000110"><dc:Bounds x="60" y="200" width="60" height="60" /><bpmndi:BPMNLabel><dc:Bounds x="74" y="266" width="32" height="16" /></bpmndi:BPMNLabel></bpmndi:BPMNShape>

    <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="NOOMNIEND00001_di" bpmnElement="NOOMNIEND00001"><dc:Bounds x="420" y="200" width="60" height="60" /><bpmndi:BPMNLabel><dc:Bounds x="406" y="266" width="88" height="16" /></bpmndi:BPMNLabel></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
